scheduler.start_condition: Wave-1 controller is terminal, all Wave-1 model services have stopped, and an independent read-only audit confirms no process references either target.
scheduler.mac_to_server_transfer: If direct download is unavailable, transfer only with resumable sftp -l 4096 and preserve the same target/evidence identities.

execution_contract.server_root_injection: Set AGENT_ENHANCE_REMOTE_ROOT immediately before execution; it must resolve to a writable project root named AgentEnhance under an approved high-capacity volume.

acceptance: Hugging Face resolves the exact immutable revision.
The selected repository file names exactly match allow_patterns.
Selected per-file bytes, file count, and byte total match the official expanded tree.
Every selected local file has a retained path, byte size, and SHA-256.
The evidence manifest and model SHA list have their own retained SHA-256 inventory.
Both evidence roots are TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and neither is TERMINAL_REJECTED.
failure: Any collision, unresolved environment variable, network error, identity mismatch, path mismatch, byte mismatch, or hash error seals a fresh TERMINAL_REJECTED evidence root, retains the partial target, and requires a separately frozen recovery target.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit both model snapshots, then freeze a dedicated Python 3.11 environment and embedded-service lifecycle. Model acceptance never authorizes a numerical run.
prohibited_actions: starting while Wave-1 or any of its model services is active
using a moving branch or model name instead of the frozen revision
downloading alternate PyTorch, Flax, ONNX, or OpenVINO weight variants
loading a model during this download-only stage
installing Hindsight into a shared or Wave-1 environment
repairing or deleting a rejected target in place
populating any comparison-table numeric cell from this gate
